title: Coherent CE quotient presentations and comparison of a supplied first-page component
statement: For every scheme $X$ and bounded-below complex $K$ of abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], there exist simultaneous termwise hypercohomology presentations $P(X,K)$ [def-weil-pbc-termwise-hypercohomology-presentation] and concrete quotient realizations $e$ [lem-weil-pbc-ce-stationary-page-naturality] satisfying quotient coherence [def-weil-pbc-filtered-quotient-coherence]. For $f:Y\to X$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], $v:f^{-1}K\to L$, an augmented bicomplex comparison $\varphi$, and a supplied sheaf-total map $u$ satisfying the nonnegative diagonal summand equation, put $b=P(X,K).\mathrm{totalSectionsIso}.\mathrm{hom}\,\mathrm{ceSectionsLift}(f,u)\,P(Y,L).\mathrm{totalSectionsIso}.\mathrm{inv}$ [lem-weil-pbc-ce-total-sections-comparison]. Fix $p\ge0,q\in\mathbf Z$. Any single first-page component $m:E_1^{q,p}(X,K)\to E_1^{q,p}(Y,L)$ with the displayed action of $b$ on all cycle representatives satisfies $m\,\mathrm{firstPageIso}_{Y,L}=\mathrm{firstPageIso}_{X,K}\,H^p(v^q)\,\mathrm{cohomologyMap}_f$ [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. The representative premise is restricted to this one bidegree on page one, exactly as in Lean. No spectral-sequence morphism or lift is constructed.

proof.text: For each X,K choose a supported augmented CE resolution using lem-weil-pbc-ce-resolution-all-lower-bounds. Apply its support assertion to any lower bound supplied by K being bounded below. The resulting I,a have the row, term, horizontal injectivity and augmentation hypotheses of lem-weil-pbc-ce-normalized-representative-cohomology; apply that theorem simultaneously to obtain P, differentials delta, page isomorphisms j, normalized successor comparisons and the local ordinary-cohomology equation. Define e by evaluating j in each bidegree.

For quotient coherence the differential is delta and the complex comparison is j. For the successor equation choose the successor-cycle cover f of the concrete page, using lem-sp-filtered-complex-successor-cycles-cover. For any x,z in the coherence premise, cancellation of the monic cycle inclusion identifies z with x followed by f and cyclesMap(j.inv). The given normalization equation for f, followed by naturality of the homology projection under j.inv, is exactly the successor equation. This is the private helper quotient_coherence_of_normalized; it applies to an arbitrary abelian category.

Fix f,K,L,v,phi,u,p,q and a supplied component m. Use the source sections-row cycles as test object. Its filtered representative is rowCycleStep; its graded representative is rowCycleClass from def-weil-pbc-ce-canonical-row-comparison. In the target precompose these two maps with cyclesMap(ceRowSectionsMap f (phi.f q)). The diagonal inclusion naturality calculation rowInclusion_naturality in lem-weil-pbc-ce-row-cycles-naturality identifies the two filtered representatives under b; the rowCycleClass_arrow equations give their graded projections. Apply both the supplied representative premise for m and the ordinary-cohomology representative equation of lem-weil-pbc-ce-normalized-representative-cohomology to this same pair. Postcompose the former equation by the target firstPageIso and compare it with the latter equation. The rowCycleClass is an isomorphism, the boundary cokernel projection is epic, and e.inv is an isomorphism. Cancel their composite to obtain the required first-page equation. No map on any other component, filtered lift, or spectral-sequence morphism is constructed.
